wholePhysicalScope: Named 56-vertex Foster Auditorium outline, separate mapped Malone-Hood Plaza and four exact public-domain Qualla photos, including three after the 2010 restoration.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the mapped auditorium, six-column portico and pediment. Near levels add the Ionic capitals, dentils, fanlights and entry railings.
limitations: The November 2010 exterior references control the restored entrance and masonry. The 2008 original informs permanent Ionic stonework. The freestanding clock tower and plaza are separate from this auditorium model.
The roof forms and heights, service elevations, glazing and Ionic volutes are approximate. The documented main volume and attached rooms follow the mapped perimeter.
The independent elevation field is preserved. Plaza pavement contact is approximate.
